build_multilingual_translation_task: build a multilingual translation task with language pairs en-de and en-fr for simultaneous training
load_multilingual_dataset: load a multilingual translation dataset split for training across multiple language pairs
train_multilingual_model: train a multilingual translation model using round-robin batching over multiple language pairs
run_multilingual_inference: run inference on a multilingual translation model with a specified source and target language
configure_encoder_decoder_langtok: configure encoder and decoder language tokens to replace beginning-of-sentence tokens with language identifiers
